metadata.title: Breach of Security Safeguards Regulations (SOR/2018-64)
metadata.legal_basis: SOR/2018-64 under PIPEDA; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Marketing authorisation holders and sponsors processing personal data in pharmacovigilance (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement: 2 (1) A report of a breach of security safeguards re ferred to in subsection 10.1(2) of the Act must be in writ ing and must contain (a) a description of the circumstances of the breach and, if known, the cause;
candidates.context: Report to Commissioner Déclaration au commissaire Report — content, form and manner Contenu et modalités de la déclaration (b) the day on which, or the period during which, the breach occurred or, if neither is known, the approxi mate period;

candidates.statement: 3 A notification provided by an organization, in accor dance with subsection 10.1(3) of the Act, to an affected individual with respect to a breach of security safeguards must contain (a) a description of the circumstances of the breach;
candidates.context: Notification to Affected Individual Avis à l’intéressé Contents of notification Contenu de l’avis (b) the day on which, or period during which, the breach occurred or, if neither is known, the approxi mate period;

candidates.statement: 4 For the purposes of subsection 10.1(5) of the Act, di rect notification must be given to the affected individual in person, by telephone, mail, email or any other form of communication that a reasonable person would consider appropriate in the circumstances.
candidates.context: Direct notification — form and manner Avis direct — modalités 4 Pour l’application du paragraphe 10.1(5) de la Loi, l’avis est donné directement à l’intéressé en personne, par téléphone, par courrier, par courriel ou par tout autre moyen de communication qu’une personne raisonnable estimerait acceptable dans les circonstances.

candidates.statement: 5 (1) For the purposes of subsection 10.1(5) of the Act, indirect notification must be given by an organization in any of the following circumstances:
candidates.context: Indirect notification — circumstances Avis indirect — circonstances (a) direct notification would be likely to cause further harm to the affected individual;

candidates.statement: c) l’organisation n’a pas les coordonnées de l’intéres sé. Indirect notification — form and manner Avis indirect — modalités (2) For the purposes of subsection 10.1(5) of the Act, in direct notification must be given by public communica tion or similar measure that could reasonably be expect ed to reach the affected individuals.
candidates.context: (c) the organization does not have contact informa tion for the affected individual. (2) Pour l’application du paragraphe 10.1(5) de la Loi, l’avis est donné indirectement par une communication publique ou par toute mesure similaire dont on peut rai sonnablement s’attendre à ce qu’elle permette de joindre l’intéressé.

candidates.statement: 6 (1) For the purposes of subsection 10.3(1) of the Act, an organization must maintain a record of every breach of security safeguards for 24 months after the day on which the organization determines that the breach has occurred.
candidates.context: Record-keeping Tenue du registre Record-keeping requirements Registre — modalité 6 (1) Pour l’application du paragraphe 10.3(1) de la Loi, l’organisation conserve le registre de toute atteinte aux mesures de sécurité pendant vingt-quatre mois après la date à laquelle elle conclut qu’il y a eu atteinte.

candidates.statement: Compliance Conformité (2) The record referred to in subsection 10.3(1) of the Act must contain any information that enables the Com missioner to verify compliance with subsections 10.1(1) and (3) of the Act.
candidates.context: 6 (1) Pour l’application du paragraphe 10.3(1) de la Loi, l’organisation conserve le registre de toute atteinte aux mesures de sécurité pendant vingt-quatre mois après la date à laquelle elle conclut qu’il y a eu atteinte. (2) Le registre visé au paragraphe 10.3(1) de la Loi contient tout renseignement qui permet au commissaire de vérifier la conformité aux paragraphes 10.1(1) et (3) de la Loi.
